evidence: Identifies A pausing through expiry, B acquiring token 2 and receiving the same job, then A resuming so both call Apply and A may MarkDone.
Requires that “only the current fencing token may perform or commit a job” and that the token be enforced atomically at MarkDone.
States that the current Apply interface cannot enforce the invariant and must change or sit behind a fenced coordinator; also requires remote atomic deduplication or authoritative reconciliation.
Treats failed renewals as “ambiguous” and requires stopping work before the last-known expiry after any uncertain renewal.
Says to “cancel and join renewal work,” but does not explicitly bind the goroutine to the Run lifecycle or require a bounded timeout for every renewal as part of that lifecycle.
Requires Release to atomically compare the stored lease identity or fencing token with the caller’s acquisition.
Gives the schedule where Apply takes effect, its response is lost, and retries may each create another non-idempotent effect.
Requires every retry and successor to reuse one stable operation identity with atomic deduplication or authoritative outcome lookup/reconciliation.
Identifies that after all three Apply calls fail without taking effect, unconditional MarkDone falsely records completion.
Explicitly flags the ignored MarkDone error and requires completion-write failure or ambiguity to remain recoverable.
Quantifies up to six effects: three attempts by A and three by successor B.
Does not require one end-to-end deadline or distinguish transient failures from permanent failures before retry; it only distinguishes ambiguous outcomes.
Does not claim acquisition or renewal alone prevents stale-owner effects; it explicitly requires authoritative fencing.
Does not allow continued unfenced work after uncertain renewal; it requires stopping before last-known expiry and fencing authoritative boundaries.
Requires retries to reuse one stable operation identity, not fresh identities.
Does not approve ignored errors; it flags ignored Renew/MarkDone consequences and requires identity-checked Release semantics.
verdict.summary: The response establishes 10 of 12 required invariants. It misses the full owned renewal-goroutine lifecycle requirement and the end-to-end deadline plus transient/permanent/ambiguous retry classification. No forbidden outcome is endorsed.
